Evidence:
[1] His musical career has spanned seven decades and as a critically acclaimed performer he was regarded as one of the best contemporary banjo players and arguably one of the all-time best.
[2] Simon's musical career has spanned seven decades, with his fame and commercial success beginning as half of the duo Simon & Garfunkel, which was formed in 1964 with Art Garfunkel.
[3] The album's title is a slight modification of the title of the duo's first major hit, "The Sound of Silence", which originally was released as "The Sounds of Silence".
